pathInstructions.instructions: When a test asserts on an error, prefer the error class or a stable code over full message strings; message-text assertions break on harmless rewording.
Scripts run in CI where output is the only trace: a failure exit must name the file or gate that failed.

contractPairs.contract: The server's response type and the client's declared twin must carry the same fields.
The audit script must accept exactly what the production validator accepts.
Every status member must be classified by the deliverability predicate.
